keyEvents.text: Zak Sturge (Millwall) is shown the red card.
Kealey Adamson (Queens Park Rangers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Lyndon Dykes (Millwall).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Millwall 0, Queens Park Rangers 1. Nicolas Madsen (Queens Park Rangers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.
Substitution, Millwall. Jordi Osei-Tutu replaces Casper De Norre.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Koki Saito replaces Boy Kemper.
Caleb Taylor (Millwall) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Millwall. Daniel Kelly replaces Lyndon Dykes.
Camiel Neghli (Millwall) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Millwall. Zak Lovelace replaces Kyrell Lisbie.
Jordi Osei-Tutu (Millwall) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Karamoko Dembélé replaces Ilias Chair.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Kwame Poku replaces Paul Smyth.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Jonathan Varane replaces Nicolas Madsen.
Substitution, Millwall. Mihailo Ivanovic replaces Taïryk Arconte.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Rumarn Burrell replaces Richard Kone.
Jake Cooper (Millwall) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
